SPIREDUO-KOALA.title: The Koala
SPIREDUO-KOALA.description: A sleepy marsupial. Builds up [gold]Drowsy[/gold] for Block, then wakes up all at once.
SPIREDUO-KOALA.goldMonologue: Gold is nice. A nap is nicer.
SPIREDUO-KOALA.cardsModifierDescription: Koala cards will appear in rewards.
SPIREDUO-PANDA.title: The Panda
SPIREDUO-PANDA.description: A sturdy bear with a basket of [gold]Bamboo[/gold], always ready to share a bite.
SPIREDUO-PANDA.cardsModifierDescription: Panda cards will appear in rewards.
SPIREDUO-BLACK_CAT.title: The Black Cat
SPIREDUO-BLACK_CAT.description: A quiet observer who turns each deliberate step into a sudden answer.
SPIREDUO-BLACK_CAT.goldMonologue: A coin makes a nice sound on the floor.
SPIREDUO-BLACK_CAT.eventDeathPrevention: Not while the moon is up.
SPIREDUO-BLACK_CAT.cardsModifierDescript: Black Cat cards will appear in rewards.
SPIREDUO-BLACK_CAT.lockedDescription: Locked. Win Act 3 with the Koala and the Panda in the same party to unlock the Black Cat.
SPIREDUO-BLACK_CAT.unlockedBanner: The Black Cat has joined you! It can now be picked at character select.
